 as an essential nutrient. An essential nutrient is a nutrient that the body cannot synthesize or
cannot synthesize in amounts adequate to meet requirements. Linoleic acid (18:2n-6) and linolenic acid (18:3n-3) and their derived
fatty acids are essential because unlike plants, humans cannot introduce a double bond after the ninth carbon in a fatty acyl chain
(from the carboxyl end).
